temporal_scope: First five seconds only; final four source frames excluded. Overlapping windows are not independent observations.
video: Decode original RGB frames with actual PTS; require 124 frames, 640x384, 24 fps and zero start. Use all 48 native frames per two-second window. Official processor bilinear resize to 336x336, no crop, no additional frame sampling or re-encoding.
audio: Require original 48 kHz stereo, zero aligned start and at least five seconds of decoded finite PCM. Arithmetic mono downmix, no resampling or gain normalization. Shift entire decoded waveform before selecting windows; zero fill and truncate, never wrap.
tone440: Replace audio with a 440 Hz sinusoid whose amplitude follows the original centered 10 ms RMS envelope, then match whole-waveform RMS. This is a deliberately implausible tonal replacement, not a pure semantic intervention or human label.
processor: Exactly 96000 samples/48 frames per window; no reflected audio padding. Require all masks valid. Model outputs must be finite [1,50,1024] paired embeddings. Preserve original alignment and record its source-index mapping; reject unsupported padding rather than patching learned behavior.
score: FP32-normalize paired audio/video frame embeddings; save both complete arrays and all 50 diagonal dot products. Raw window score is their arithmetic mean. Case score is the equal mean of its three window scores; not a human rating, confidence, or calibrated probability.
silence: Compute and retain raw output for diagnostics, but report synchronization as unassessable for an exactly silent waveform. This is a harness guard, not learned silence detection.
precision: FP32 parameters, CUDA BF16 autocast, evaluation/inference mode, batch one, four CPU threads, seed 20260909; no training, quantization, adapter merge, compile or external kernels.
runtime: Use existing idle GPU only after verifying ComfyUI 8189 queue empty and >=20 GiB free. Check queue before every window. Stop evaluator on occupied/unknown queue; never start/stop/unload ComfyUI.
technical_gate: Every frozen case/window succeeds, expected tensor shapes/masks and finite values; exact loaded checkpoint/adapter coverage.
necessary_sensitivity_gate: For already-rated strong-sync control A05, original mean score must exceed both +/-750 ms and tone440 by >0.0001. A09 and +/-80/125 ms are descriptive, not required to prefer the unchanged source.
repeatability_gate: A05 original and delay750 repeated full diagonal vectors differ by <=0.00001, with identical input hashes.
stop_rule: Any failed necessary gate means no natural-clip ranking sweep under this policy. Passing gates permits proposing a separate frozen natural calibration, never automatic held-out access or production integration.
scope_limitations: Only two previously rated H3 boxing sources, one human reviewer, no perceptual listening by assistant. Fine shifts can accidentally improve an imperfect source. Window features have contextual receptive fields, not independently detected event onsets.
